sources.name: Board-supplied example decklist (DEC-544)
sources.detail: Starting point given by the board on DEC-544. 14 cards carried over (Atla, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Skullclamp, Goblin Bombardment, Phyrexian Altar, Sylvan Library, Heroic Intervention, Etali, Zacama, Blightsteel Colossus, Titan of Industry, Command Beacon, Command Tower) plus the Nature's Lore ramp core and the shock/fetch manabase. Stats-only bodies, defensive locks, soft single-target tricks and tapped lands were dropped against the impact-on-arrival bar.

sources.name: EDHREC — Atla Palani, Nest Tender
sources.detail: DEC-402 closing diff run 2026-08-22 on the final 99. Lightning Greaves (51%) and Beast Within (43%) were added by the diff. Rejected with reasons: Etali, Primal Storm (attack-gated), Zetalpa and the Ghalta family (stats or combat only), Cultivate / Rampant Growth / Kodama's Reach (tapped-basic ramp), Dinosaur Egg (dud flip), Swiftfoot Boots, and the tapped-land cycle (Jungle Shrine, Cinder Glade, Canopy Vista). Deferred: Sundering Growth, Rhythm of the Wild.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — find-my-combos on the exact 99
sources.detail: 6 included combo lines, all running through the commander: Maskwood Nexus with each of the three free outlets, Thornbite Staff + Ashnod's Altar, and Mirror Entity with Worldspine Wurm or Vigor. 273 near-misses triaged and rejected — each one imports a different combo archetype's pieces and would dilute the flip quality without making the deck faster.

sources.name: DEC-544 CEO deck build and soundness review (2026-08-22)
sources.detail: Strategy A (Egg-death hatching into an all-bombs library) chosen over the Dinosaur-tribal and token-swarm alternatives, then rebuilt to a true bracket 4 with a free-spell protection suite. Board-accepted amendments A1-A5. Soundness review passed four checks: metrics reproduction, full Scryfall mirror sweep (Naya identity, Commander legality, no duplicates, no board-banned price cards), internal reference check, and clause-by-clause re-derivation of the Mirror Entity and Thornbite Staff lines. Build spec: agents/ceo/analysis/dec544-build-spec.json.

sources.name: Scryfall — oracle text verification
sources.detail: All 100 names (99 + commander) resolved and oracle-verified against the local mirror.

sources.name: Swap round 1 — DEC-570 11-card assessment (board-approved 2026-08-28)
sources.detail: Interaction 54035e8b, all four items approved: Idol of Oblivion -> Caretaker's Talent (same token-trigger class, up to 4 draws per turn cycle with Smothering Tithe vs Idol's 1 — Idol untaps only during our untap step; both are Enlightened Tutor targets), Gamble -> Winds of Abandon (one-sided overload exile clears the removal-board 2/3 gap; cut was the weakest of 7 tutors — random discard risk; exiled controllers fetch basics), Warleader's Call -> Elspeth, Storm Slayer (second token doubler beside Mondrak: one Atla activation makes 2 Eggs, 4 with both out, CR 616 multiplicative; pinger suite drops 4 -> 3), 1 Plains -> Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire (untapped W source plus a channel mode: 4 damage to an attacking or blocking creature, {1} cheaper per legendary creature). All adds oracle-verified via Scryfall; no add is a Game Changer, and the Gamble cut drops the deck's Game Changer count 8 -> 7 (bracket 4 is uncapped, so the label holds). Akroma's Will deferred (kept Flawless Maneuver — free with commander out beats 4 mana on tap-out hatch turns).

sources.name: Swap round 2 — DEC-574 board-approved (2026-08-29)
sources.detail: Interaction 06484257, four swaps approved plus a conditional fifth. ADD Greater Good / CUT Wild Growth, ADD Idol of Oblivion / CUT Titan of Industry, ADD Shamanic Revelation / CUT Heroic Intervention (protection 7 -> 6; Flawless Maneuver stays — free with the commander out beats paying mana on tap-out hatch turns; Heroic 40.6% on Atla EDHREC, named override), ADD Warstorm Surge / CUT Impact Tremors (same converter slot: mean flip power 5.74 to any target vs 1 to each opponent; Tremors 6.1% on Atla EDHREC and in no Spellbook combo). Draw rises 7 -> 10 (on target), ramp 11 -> 10 (on target). Fifth swap under the board's condition (approve the ~EUR 18 Solphim rebuy if together with a cut it makes the deck stronger and more consistent): ADD Solphim, Mayhem Dominus / CUT Sun Titan. Sun Titan was the weakest creature slot — a mid-power flip in a graveyard-light deck with zero prose, combo or category references, and recursion is not a scored role. Solphim doubles all noncombat damage to opponents (converter output 17.5 -> 35 per Egg death; table kill at 4 deaths instead of 7), is hatchable by Atla, reachable by 4 of 6 tutors, and improves the curve (6 MV out, 4 MV in). All five adds oracle-verified via Scryfall; no add is a Game Changer, so the count stays 7.

guideContent.strategyOverview:
Broodfire Hatchery is a Naya combo deck with a single question at its centre: how many Eggs can you kill this turn? Atla Palani, Nest Tender pays {2} and taps to make a 0/1 Egg token, and whenever an Egg you control dies she reveals cards from the top of your library until she hits a creature card and puts it straight onto the battlefield. Every Egg death is therefore a free creature, so the 99 is stocked almost entirely with bodies that change the game the moment they arrive — Craterhoof Behemoth, Avacyn, Angel of Hope, Etali, Primal Conqueror, Blightsteel Colossus, Zacama, Primal Calamity, Apex Altisaur. A random flip is never a blank.

Speed comes from free sacrifice outlets. Ashnod's Altar, Phyrexian Altar, Goblin Bombardment, Skullclamp and High Market all kill an Egg for no mana, so an Egg can be cashed in the moment it is made. Maskwood Nexus makes every creature you control every creature type — which means every creature you control is an Egg — so any free outlet becomes a repeatable "sacrifice a creature, hatch a new one" engine; three of the deck's six Spellbook-verified lines run through it. Thornbite Staff gives Atla "whenever a creature dies, untap this creature", so with Ashnod's Altar the loop is mana-neutral: pay {2} and tap Atla for an Egg, sacrifice the Egg for {C}{C}, the death untaps Atla, repeat. Because Atla is a Shaman, the Staff attaches to her for free if it is already on the battlefield when she enters.

Mirror Entity is the widest line of all. With Atla out, activate Mirror Entity for X=0: every creature you control has base power and toughness 0/0 and gains all creature types, so the whole board is a pile of Eggs that dies at once and Atla triggers for each of them. Worldspine Wurm and Vigor shuffle themselves back into the library whenever they hit the graveyard, so the cascade keeps finding fuel instead of burning out.

None of this needs an attack step. Purphoros, God of the Forge, Warstorm Surge and Terror of the Peaks all trigger on each creature entering, so a mass hatch converts directly into noncombat damage and kills the table from an empty-looking board. Craterhoof Behemoth is the combat backup when the table is playing damage prevention. Mondrak, Glory Dominus and Elspeth, Storm Slayer each double every Egg token — with both out one Atla activation makes four Eggs — Roaming Throne (naming Shaman) doubles Atla's death trigger for two flips per Egg, and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines doubles every enters-the-battlefield trigger the hatched creatures cause. Solphim, Mayhem Dominus doubles all noncombat damage your sources deal to opponents, so every converter trigger hits twice as hard — and Solphim is itself a creature, so Atla can hatch it.

Support is built for a combo deck: 10 ramp sources, 6 tutors that can find either half of any line, 10 draw pieces, 6 protection pieces (Deflecting Swat and Flawless Maneuver are free with the commander out, Clever Concealment phases the board out of a wipe), and interaction chosen for hoser coverage. The deck's number one hate card is Grafdigger's Cage, which stops creature cards in libraries from entering the battlefield and blanks Atla outright; Aura Shards answers it every time a creature enters, and Krosan Grip, Force of Vigor, Boseiju, Who Endures and Beast Within cover artifacts, enchantments and lands so no resolved hoser sticks. Winds of Abandon overloaded exiles every creature the deck's opponents control while the Egg board stays put. Bracket 4 with 7 Game Changers. The deck is tagged brewing until the goldfish simulation confirms the turn-6 kill rate.

deckCategories.name: The Egg Engine
deckCategories.description: Atla turns Egg deaths into free creatures, so the deck's real mana sink is making more Eggs and untapping her. Maskwood Nexus makes every creature an Egg, Thornbite Staff untaps Atla on every death, Mondrak and Elspeth, Storm Slayer each double every Egg token (with both out one activation makes four Eggs), and Roaming Throne (naming Shaman) makes Atla's death trigger fire twice. Palani's Hatcher and Nesting Dragon keep making Eggs if Atla is answered.

deckCategories.name: Free Sacrifice Outlets
deckCategories.description: An Egg is worth nothing until it dies. Every outlet here costs no mana, so an Egg made this turn hatches this turn, and a board full of Eggs empties in one go.

deckCategories.name: Damage Converters
deckCategories.description: Purphoros, Warstorm Surge and Terror of the Peaks each trigger on a creature entering, which is exactly what a mass hatch produces — Warstorm and Terror deal the entering creature's power, so every hatched bomb is a burn spell. Solphim doubles all noncombat damage aimed at opponents, halving the number of Egg deaths a lethal cascade needs. Together they kill the table without ever attacking.

deckCategories.name: Bombs to Hatch
deckCategories.description: The library is the deck's hand. Every creature here wins, sweeps, or draws the game open on arrival, so a blind flip off Atla is always worth the Egg. Worldspine Wurm and Vigor shuffle back from the graveyard and become fuel again.
cards: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

deckCategories.name: Tutors
deckCategories.description: Six tutors cover both halves of every line: Enlightened Tutor finds Thornbite Staff, Maskwood Nexus, Caretaker's Talent or either Altar; Worldly Tutor, Eladamri's Call, Chord of Calling and Natural Order find Mirror Entity or a bomb.

deckCategories.name: Protection for the Combo Turn
deckCategories.description: The deck goes off at sorcery speed with the commander on the battlefield, so every protection piece is chosen to be live on that turn. Deflecting Swat and Flawless Maneuver cost nothing while Atla is out, and Clever Concealment phases the whole board out of a wipe.

deckCategories.name: Interaction and Hoser Coverage
deckCategories.description: Grafdigger's Cage is the card that beats this deck outright — creature cards in libraries can't enter the battlefield, so Atla stops hatching. Aura Shards destroys an artifact or enchantment every time a creature enters, and Krosan Grip, Force of Vigor, Boseiju and Beast Within cover artifacts, enchantments and lands between them.

deckCategories.name: Ramp and Fixing
deckCategories.description: Atla wants to land on turn 3 and activate the same turn, so the ramp is cheap and untapped: the Nature's Lore class fetches shock duals untapped, Utopia Sprawl adds mana without diluting the creature count, and Jeska's Will pays for a whole combo turn.

deckCategories.name: Card Advantage
deckCategories.description: Draw is tied to the plan rather than bolted on: Guardian Project and Garruk's Uprising fire on the creatures Atla hatches, Skullclamp turns a 0/1 Egg into two cards, and Caretaker's Talent draws the first time tokens enter under your control each turn — with Smothering Tithe that is every turn of the cycle, and its level 2 copies an Egg or a Treasure. Idol of Oblivion draws a card every turn the deck makes a token, Greater Good cashes in a hatched bomb — or a creature about to die anyway — for cards equal to its power, and Shamanic Revelation refills the hand off the board a cascade just built.

deckCategories.name: Key Lands
deckCategories.description: 36 lands, 35 of them untapped on arrival. Command Beacon recasts Atla past commander tax, High Market is a sacrifice outlet in a land slot, Boseiju is removal that costs no card, and Eiganjo channels from hand for 4 damage to an attacking or blocking creature ({1} cheaper per legendary creature you control).

winConditions.title: Nest Cascade
winConditions.description: With Atla out, activate Mirror Entity for X=0: every creature you control becomes a 0/0 Egg and dies. Atla reveals until a creature card and puts it onto the battlefield for each death, flooding the board with bombs. Worldspine Wurm and Vigor shuffle back from the graveyard, so repeat activations keep finding fuel.

winConditions.title: Thornbite Hatch Engine
winConditions.description: Equip Thornbite Staff to Atla. Pay {2},{T} for an Egg, sacrifice it to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}, and the death untaps Atla via the Staff. Each mana-neutral loop hatches a creature off the top of the library.

winConditions.title: Hatch-and-Burn
winConditions.description: Mass hatches convert directly to noncombat damage: each hatched bomb triggers every ETB-damage payoff, so a Mirror Entity cascade kills the table without attacking. Solphim, Mayhem Dominus doubles the noncombat damage, halving the number of Egg deaths a lethal cascade needs.

winConditions.title: Titan Combat
cards: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness
winConditions.description: The fair plan: cheat 8-plus-mana bodies into play early through egg deaths and swing.

synergies.title: Maskwood Nexus + Ashnod's Altar = dump the library for mana
synergies.description: Maskwood Nexus makes every creature you control every creature type, so every creature you control is an Egg. Sacrifice any creature to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}; the Egg death triggers Atla, which puts the next creature card off the top of your library onto the battlefield; sacrifice that one too. Each iteration nets {C}{C}, so you can run through the library and finish with a huge mana pool. Any converter on the battlefield turns the chain into lethal damage. Verified line: https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/240-643-2034/

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Maskwood Nexus + Ashnod's Altar
sources.detail: Maskwood makes every creature an Egg; each sac hatches.

synergies.title: Maskwood Nexus + Phyrexian Altar = dump the library for colored mana
synergies.description: The same line on the colored-mana altar: with Maskwood Nexus out, every creature is an Egg, so each sacrifice to Phyrexian Altar adds one mana of any color and hatches the next creature. Worth running alongside the Ashnod's version because the colored mana casts whatever the chain reveals. Verified line: https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/240-643-4050/

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Maskwood Nexus + Phyrexian Altar
sources.detail: Same line on the colored-mana altar.

synergies.title: Maskwood Nexus + Goblin Bombardment = dump the library and burn the table
synergies.description: With Maskwood Nexus out, Goblin Bombardment sacrifices any creature for one damage and each death hatches the next creature off the library. The chain is its own win condition — no separate converter needed — because every iteration pings a player for 1 while the board grows. Verified line: https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/240-643-5147/

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Maskwood Nexus + Goblin Bombardment
sources.detail: Same line converting each sac into 1 damage.

synergies.title: Thornbite Staff + Ashnod's Altar = mana-neutral repeat hatching
synergies.description: Equip Thornbite Staff to Atla (free if the Staff is already out when she enters, since she is a Shaman). Pay {2} and tap Atla for a 0/1 Egg, sacrifice the Egg to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}, and the death untaps Atla through the Staff. Net mana zero, one hatch per loop, and it is fully deterministic — no Maskwood Nexus required. Verified line: https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/240-2034-2178/

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Thornbite Staff + Ashnod's Altar
sources.detail: Mana-neutral repeat hatches; see Thornbite Hatch Engine.

synergies.title: Mirror Entity + Worldspine Wurm = recurring mass hatch
synergies.description: Activate Mirror Entity for X=0 with Atla on the battlefield: every creature you control has base power and toughness 0/0 and gains all creature types, so they are all Eggs and all die at once. Atla triggers once per death and hatches a bomb for each. Creatures that arrive afterwards are not shrunk, because the effect locked in its set of creatures on resolution. Worldspine Wurm shuffles itself back into the library from the graveyard, so the next activation still has fuel. Verified line: https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/240-4486-5209/

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Mirror Entity + Worldspine Wurm

synergies.title: Mirror Entity + Vigor = second recurring mass hatch
synergies.description: The same mass-Egg activation with Vigor as the recurring fuel: Vigor shuffles itself back into the library whenever it hits the graveyard, so repeated Mirror Entity activations keep drawing live creature cards. Vigor also prevents damage to your other creatures and converts it into +1/+1 counters, which matters when the table answers a hatched board with damage-based removal. Verified line: https://commanderspellbook.com/combo/240-4120-4486/

sources.name: Commander Spellbook — Mirror Entity + Vigor
sources.detail: Second shuffle body for the Nest Cascade.

highlights.name: Atla Palani, Nest Tender
highlights.reason: Commander. {2}, {T} makes a 0/1 Egg; whenever an Egg you control dies she reveals cards until she hits a creature card and puts it onto the battlefield. Every line in the deck is a way to kill Eggs faster.

highlights.name: Mirror Entity
highlights.reason: The widest line. Activate for X=0 with Atla out: every creature you control becomes a 0/0 with all creature types and dies at once, and Atla hatches a bomb for each death.

highlights.name: Maskwood Nexus
highlights.reason: Makes every creature you control every creature type, so every creature is an Egg. Turns any free sacrifice outlet into a repeatable hatch engine — three of the six verified combo lines run through it.

highlights.name: Thornbite Staff
highlights.reason: Gives Atla "whenever a creature dies, untap this creature". With Ashnod's Altar the hatch loop is mana-neutral. Attaches to Atla for free because she is a Shaman.

highlights.name: Ashnod's Altar
highlights.reason: Free outlet that pays you {C}{C} per Egg. The mana half of the Thornbite loop and the outlet in two of the six verified combo lines.

highlights.name: Purphoros, God of the Forge
highlights.reason: Converter and indestructible. Two damage to each opponent per hatched creature turns a single mass hatch into a table kill with no attack step.

highlights.name: Terror of the Peaks
highlights.reason: The heaviest converter: damage equal to each entering creature's power, aimed anywhere. One cascade of fatties ends the game.

highlights.name: Roaming Throne
highlights.reason: Name Shaman and Atla's death trigger fires twice — two flips per Egg. The single biggest multiplier on the engine.

highlights.name: Seedborn Muse
highlights.reason: Game Changer. Untaps Atla during every opponent's untap step: an Egg per player per turn cycle (×3 in a four-player game) while leaving mana open for Chord of Calling and free protection.

highlights.name: Natural Order
highlights.reason: Game Changer. Sacrifice a green Egg — which itself triggers Atla — and put Craterhoof Behemoth, Vigor or Worldspine Wurm straight onto the battlefield.

highlights.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
highlights.reason: The combat backup. Any board built by a cascade of hatches becomes lethal damage the turn Craterhoof arrives, hard-cast or flipped.

highlights.name: Worldspine Wurm
highlights.reason: Shuffles itself back into the library from anywhere, so it is permanent fuel for repeated Mirror Entity activations, and it leaves three 5/5 trample tokens behind each time it dies.
